workflows.name: Successful login with valid test user
workflows.conditional_branch: Username in {standard_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user} AND Password == secret_sauce
workflows.on_success: System authenticates and redirects to the Product Inventory page.

workflows.name: Login attempt with empty Username
workflows.on_success: Epic sadface: Username is required.

workflows.name: Login attempt with empty Password
workflows.on_success: Epic sadface: Password is required.

workflows.name: Login attempt by locked out user
workflows.on_success: Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.

workflows.name: Login attempt with invalid credentials
workflows.conditional_branch: Username not in {standard_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user, locked_out_user} OR Password != secret_sauce
workflows.on_success: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.

workflows.name: Add a product to cart
workflows.on_success: Item added to cart; the button changes to "Remove"; cart badge count updates accordingly.

workflows.name: Remove a product from cart
workflows.on_success: Item removed from cart; the button changes back to "Add to cart"; cart badge count updates accordingly.

workflows.name: Open Product Detail by clicking product name
workflows.on_success: Product Detail page opens for the selected product.

workflows.name: Open Product Detail by clicking product image
workflows.on_success: Product Detail page opens for the selected product.

workflows.name: Sort products by Name (A–Z)
workflows.on_success: Product list is sorted by name in ascending (A–Z) order.

workflows.name: Sort products by Name (Z–A)
workflows.on_success: Product list is sorted by name in descending (Z–A) order.

workflows.name: Sort products by Price (low–high)
workflows.on_success: Product list is sorted by price from low to high.

workflows.name: Sort products by Price (high–low)
workflows.on_success: Product list is sorted by price from high to low.

workflows.name: Add product to cart
workflows.on_success: Product added to cart; page reflects updated cart state

workflows.name: Remove product from cart
workflows.on_success: Product removed from cart; page reflects updated cart state

workflows.name: Return to Product Inventory
workflows.on_success: Returns to the Product Inventory page

workflows.name: Open Shopping Cart via cart icon
workflows.on_success: Navigates to the Shopping Cart page

workflows.name: Remove item from cart
workflows.on_success: Item removed from cart; cart updated

workflows.name: Continue shopping (return to Product Inventory)
workflows.on_success: Return to Product Inventory

workflows.name: Begin checkout
workflows.on_success: Begin checkout

workflows.name: Continue with all required fields present
workflows.conditional_branch: First_Name != missing AND Last_Name != missing AND Postal_Code != missing
workflows.on_success: Proceeds to the overview step.

workflows.name: Continue with First Name missing
workflows.on_success: Displays error banner: Error: First Name is required

workflows.name: Continue with Last Name missing
workflows.on_success: Displays error banner: Error: Last Name is required

workflows.name: Continue with Postal Code missing
workflows.on_success: Displays error banner: Error: Postal Code is required

workflows.name: Cancel returns to Shopping Cart
workflows.on_success: Returns to the Shopping Cart.

workflows.name: Complete order via Finish
workflows.on_success: Completes the order and navigates to the confirmation page.

workflows.name: Exit checkout via Cancel
workflows.on_success: Exits checkout.

workflows.name: Back Home button returns to Product Inventory and clears cart
workflows.on_success: Navigates to Product Inventory and clears the cart.

workflows.name: User initiates logout
workflows.on_success: Ends the session and returns the user to the login page. After logout, protected pages (inventory, detail, cart, checkout) are not accessible without logging in again.

workflows.name: Reset app state (clear cart and UI state)
workflows.on_success: Clears the cart and resets in-app state (e.g., cart badge and add/remove button states) without logging the user out.
